senses.gloss: Atharva = Śiva: XIII, 901; do. (C.) or Āº (B.), pl. = Artharvaveda: XIII, 4706.
Atharvaśiras^1, an Upanishad (v. BR.): I, 2882; III, 17066; XIII, 4298. Do.^2 = Mahāpurusha (Maº Puºstº).

Atharvan^1 (a ṛshi). § 493 (Āṅgirasa): III, 222, 14215 (finds out Agni in the sea), 14218, 14225, 14226, 14227.-§ 560 (Santsujātap.): V, 43, †1670.--§ 606 (Tripurākhy.): VIII, 34, 1497 (Atharvāṅgirasau).--§ 730 (Ānuśāsan.): XIII, 14, 991 (sa-Bṛhaspatiḥ).
Atharvan^2 = Atharvaveda: XII, 13136 (Ṛgveda sa-Yajurveda 'thaivātharva-Sāmasu), 13258 (pañcakalpam Atharvāṇaṃ kṛtyābhiḥ parivṛṃhitaṃ); XIII, 4590 (vedaṃ)
Atharvan^3, pl. = Atharvaveda: III, 12963 (Atharvaṇaḥ); V, 1711 (Atharvasu); XII, 8613.
Ātharvaṇa (“belonging to or named after Atharvan”): V, 1391; VII, 2851 (sthānam Ātharvaṇasya); VIII, 1848, †4625 (“which in efficacy equalled an Atharvan rite,” PCR.); XIII, 1086 (Ātharvaṇā dvijāḥ).

Atharvāṅgirasa^1 = Aṅgiras: II, 437 (?; in the palace of Brahmán); V, 550 (ºo nāma vede 'smin vai bhavishyati). Do.^2, adj.: VIII, 3488 (Atharvāṅgirasī śrutiḥ), 4795 (kṛtyām ºīm iv ogrāṃ); IX, 907 (= do.).
Atharvāṅgirasaḥ (pl.), a kind of ṛshis? (II, 437; = Atharvaveda?).
Atharvāṅgirasāḥ (pl.): XII, 12736 (Yajur-Ṛk-Sāmabhir jushṭam Atharvāṅgirasais tathā, i.e. Atharvaveda).
Atharvaveda: I, 2883 (ºpravarāḥ); II, 450; III, 15147 (ºproktaiḥ); V, 548 (ºmantraiḥ); XIII, 469 (ºveda vede ca).
